subject: Mobile Development
title: Strava's Military Base Exposure
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Strava's Military Base Exposure.

hook.text: A fitness app accidentally revealed the locations of secret military bases around the world.

buildup.text: Strava published a global heat map showing where its users exercised most frequently.

discovery.text: In dark, remote areas, bright spots on the heat map perfectly outlined military compounds.

twist.text: Soldiers had been tracking their runs around bases, creating detailed outlines on the map.

climax.text: Strava proved that aggregated fitness data can become a national security threat.

punchline.text: Jogging soldiers mapped their own secret bases.

quiz.question: How did Strava expose military bases?
options: Soldiers' tracked runs outlined bases on a public heat map
The military shared the data on purpose
